Biggest avoidable friction: focused staged test selection
`review.py task-tests` supplies the required copied namespace but cannot select one pytest node, while bare pytest cannot import that namespace. Add a `--nodeid` or safe pytest-argument passthrough so red-green regressions can run source-bound without rerunning the whole task suite.

Changed-target `task-tests` collected only the inherited root `test_generator_*.py`, whose hardcoded machine-specific canonical path fails in the isolated runtime, and omitted the new allowed `tests/test_*.py` suites. Generate inherited tests with `reviewer_support.find_root()`/`canonical_path()` and collect all task-local `tests/test_*.py` files.

The packet's advertised `shared/tools/generator_defect_lint.py` and `rule_smoke.py` fail immediately because they import `scripts.generator_module_loader` while only `shared/tools/generator_module_loader.py` is packaged; switch these to a same-directory import or include the expected `scripts` package so focused reviewers can use the provided tools without path surgery.

Biggest avoidable friction: task-tests omit task-local parametric tests

`review.py task-tests` collected only `generators/TASK/tests` and omitted the 17 tests under `workspace/parametric/tests`, creating an easy false-green path. When `promotion.json` exists, include that parametric test directory automatically or print a prominent omitted-suite warning and exact follow-up command.
